{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
count_neg999 = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
total_rows = len(data)

print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}')
print(f'Count of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {count_neg999}')
print(f'Total rows: {total_rows}')"}
